description: Search CAPEC attack patterns by every whitespace-separated text token, recorded CWE or ATT&CK mapping, abstraction, severity, or likelihood. Text tokens match at word starts or camelCase humps; tokens of at least four Unicode letters also match after exactly one un or mis prefix at a word start (config finds misconfiguration), with possible spelling coincidences. Search other compounds such as deserialization as written. Parent ATT&CK techniques include recorded subtechniques; CWE mappings are exact without hierarchy expansion. Omit filters to browse. Deprecated and Obsolete patterns are excluded by default. Mappings are incomplete and do not validate current ATT&CK coverage. Results order by all tokens in the name or in one recorded alternate term such as MITM, then all in the description, then any other match, then numeric ID; use cwe_get_attack_pattern for complete sections and follow nextCursor for remaining matches.

abstraction.description: Exact CAPEC abstraction; blank means unset.

attackTechniqueId.description: Recorded Tdddd or Tdddd.ddd mapping from cwe_get_attack_pattern mappings, also accepting bare numeric form; blank means unset.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation returned by this tool.

cweId.description: Exact recorded CWE mapping, a CWE ID such as CWE-79 or 79 from cwe_search_weaknesses; blank means unset.

filter.description: All-token case-insensitive filter over the name, recorded alternate terms, and description; each token matches at a word start or camelCase hump (path finds XPath). Tokens of at least four Unicode letters also match after exactly one un or mis prefix at a word start; spelling coincidences can match. Blank means unset.

includeInactive.description: Include Deprecated and Obsolete patterns; default false.

likelihood.description: Exact source likelihood; discover with cwe_list_reference topic filter_values.

limit.description: Maximum page size; capped at 100 and a 24,000-byte response budget with disclosure.

severity.description: Exact source severity; discover with cwe_list_reference topic filter_values.

name: cwe_search_attack_patterns

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_filter`: Unsupported CAPEC vocabulary value. `invalid_cursor`: Cursor is incompatible with inputs or catalog. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation for the same normalized query.

attackTechniqueIds.description: Recorded ATT&CK IDs; not a current validation.

descriptionPreview.description: First complete sentence of the CommonMark description.

title: Search CAPEC attack patterns
